subject: Spot merit + equity refresh approval path for Priya Natarajan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: spot merit + equity refresh approval for Priya N.

Vivek / Monica —

Quick request coming out of calibration: Priya (Eng, Product Infrastructure) is a clear outlier in impact this cycle. She led the latency-reduction initiative that cut p95 tail by 30% and shipped the cross-region failover work that ate a lot of operational risk. Calibration recommended moving her to the top of band and granting an equity refresh to keep her aligned with market.

Proposed package (manager recommendation):
- Merit increase: 12% (base uplift, exceeds standard band move of 8%)
- Spot bonus: $12,000 (one-time, retention-focused)
- Equity refresh: 0.05% (RSU target uplift; outside regular refresh cadence)

I know this exceeds normal comp band allowances for a non-manager IC; asking for an exception approval and fast-path to get offers/changes out before the next hiring round. Quick notes attached: calibration_notes.pdf and a proposed_comp_matrix.xlsx with market comps and leveling rationale.

Key asks:
1) Policy/HR approval for exception to band uplift + equity outside refresh window.
2) Finance/comp sign-off on the spot bonus amount and tax handling (I can loop Finance after HR sign-off).
3) DocuSign path for Priya to accept the spot/RSU grant if approved.

Priya — I included you for visibility; please don't reply unless you want to add anything.

Thanks,

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: calibration_notes.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: proposed_comp_matrix.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: spot merit + equity refresh approval for Priya N.

Thanks Laura — read the attachments. High level: I support retention for high-impact solo contributors, but we need a tighter justification packet before I escalate the exception to exec comp sign-off. Please provide the items below so I can route to Finance and Legal in one pass:

1) Peer comp comparisons for 3 market companies (already half there in the Excel but missing raw compbench export)
2) Short impact memo (one page) from product lead outlining business metrics improved and estimated dollar value to the company from the projects you called out
3) Suggested fallback if full equity refresh approved is denied (e.g., phased RSU or expanded spot bonus with clawback conditions)

Also: timeline — what is the target effective date? If we want this executed before the end of Q1, we need approvals by next Thursday (26 Feb). If that timing is tight, note it clearly.

I will also loop Naomi in comp ops once we have the packet so she can prep the exception form. Monica, can you confirm whether a 0.05% uplift is outside the current refresh policy thresholds?

Vivek
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: spot merit + equity refresh approval for Priya N.

Thanks Vivek — attached is a compact packet: compbench_snapshot.pdf with raw peer exports (from CompBench), plus a one-page impact memo in the Google doc link. Highlights:
- CompBench median for comparable Sr Lead roles is at ~0.9x of Priya's current cash + 0.06% typical RSU; Priya's offer puts her below market in total comp which increases flight risk (examples listed in the attachment).
- Product lead (S. Alvarez) wrote the impact memo and quantified the latency project savings as $1.2M/year in avoided infra costs and estimated revenue retention benefit of ~$800k/year.
- Fallback proposal: if equity refresh cannot be fully approved, we propose a two-step RSU grant (0.03% now, additional 0.02% after six months contingent on retention).

Time: we need to finalize by EOD 26 Feb to align with internal payroll/RSU grant window. Can Naomi/Monica confirm if that's feasible?

Attachments: compbench_snapshot.pdf
Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b_comp_justification

— Laura
[Attachment: compbench_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: spot merit + equity refresh approval for Priya N. — Exception approval (partial)

Folks — sorry for the slightly delayed response; I pushed this through comp ops and legal. Summary of decisions and next steps:

1) Merit increase: Approved at 10% effective 2026-03-01 (partial approval; Laura's requested 12% reduced to align with band uplift limits plus exception).
2) Spot bonus: Approved at $12,000 — will be paid in the next payroll cycle and processed as a one-time discretionary bonus.
3) Equity refresh (RSU): Conditional approval for a phased grant: 0.03% now, 0.02% after six months contingent on continued employment and successful post-change review. This mirrors the fallback you proposed. Legal requires the phased structure to be documented in the exception form.

I have attached the signed exception form (signed_exception_form.pdf) and opened the DocuSign envelope for Priya to accept the equity terms: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/123456789. Please route to Priya and have her sign by 5 Mar to meet the RSU grant window.

Finance note: The award has been encoded as a QA exception (deal_id: COMP-EX-2026-027) so Finance can reconcile the cost center. Monica (Comp Ops) will handle tax withholding logistics; Priya, you will see the bonus on your 3/15 paycheck.

If anyone wants to push for the full 12% merit, we can escalate to the EVP but we'd need a material business case beyond what's in the packet and a headcount/ops budget cover. For now, this is a compromise to close quickly.

Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, People Operations — Compensation
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed_exception_form.pdf (PDF)]
